name: GEVS Level 4 — essence-driven goals (spatial layer 4)
description: essence-daybed-nap: seed the operator's derived state (energy 0.2 via the test-only presence override __ardy.setEssenceState) → the essence driver fires daybed.nap on its poll cadence; planner.goalSource shows {kind:'essence', rule:'energy-low', state snapshot} so the 'she lay down because energy 0.24' story is legible in telemetry + the prompt log. The goal then executes through the normal planner (arrival within tolerance + the manifest nap interaction prompt). Rule matching/cooldown/hysteresis/priority are unit-tested; this check proves the LIVE loop: state in → the body follows. The override is cleared after the check so later checks see the real presence.

assertions.basis: the essence driver must fire from the seeded state (planner.goalSource.kind == 'essence')
energy 0.2 < 0.30 → rule energy-low (the spec's first drive rule)
goalSource.state must carry the snapshot that matched (the legible 'because energy 0.2')
the essence goal must reach the interact/done phase (telemetry phase at the first interact sample)
spec ARRIVE_TOLERANCE_M 0.35 against the RESOLVED daybed standing point, +0.1 m 2 Hz sampling slack
the manifest nap prompt ('a person lies down on a daybed') must appear in the planner prompt log
no drift-watchdog gate trips during the goal
no residual-clamp stream resets beyond the expected prompt transitions
stream stays live through the driver-fired turn/walk/arrive/interact
